headline: Keep Promises, Together
subheadline: Set a goal, check in daily, and let your friends see it land.
bullet_points: A daily check-in rail you swipe, not a form you fill
Prove it with a photo, a link, or a note, whichever fits the goal
Per-goal reminders at the hour you choose, repeating until it is done

headline: Give Every Dollar A Job
subheadline: Envelopes, projects and savings, so the plan and the month agree.
bullet_points: Envelopes that show planned against actually spent
Projects, savings pots and fixed charges in one place
Connect your bank or type it in, your call

headline: Learn Money, Slowly
subheadline: Four courses that start at zero and end with you investing on your own.
bullet_points: 52 lessons across 13 modules, each ending on one thing to do
Every financial word explained where you meet it, not in a footnote
Written for Canada, France, the US and the franc zone

headline: Your Day, One Screen
subheadline: Water, mood, classes and deadlines, without opening four apps.
bullet_points: Log water in ml or oz, from your bottle, not in glasses
Your week, your classes and what is due, on one strip
Reminders that tighten when you fall behind and space out when you catch up

headline: Nobody Drops Off Quietly
subheadline: A group that notices when someone goes silent, and says so kindly.
bullet_points: A standing that moves the day somebody finishes what they said
One tap to answer a friend asking after you
Say something out loud when a friend does something worth it
